This is a **web-based form builder or landing page editor** (likely a "Notion-style" page creator) with an **Arabic interface**.

**Center Preview Area:**
The main content shows a **form titled "الطلب" (The Order/Request)**. It contains several input fields including:
- Service name ("خدمة رسم حواجب" - Eyebrow drawing service)
- Price ("3,500 ريال")
- Location
- A detailed description text area
- Dropdown selectors for city, category, payment method, and order status

**Right Panel:**
There is **no visible right panel** in this specific screenshot. The image shows a single-column layout focused entirely on the form editor/preview. (If this is part of a larger UI, the right panel might be collapsed, off-screen, or this view represents the "editing" mode where properties would typically appear on the side).

**Overall:** It's a clean, minimal form creation interface for booking or ordering services, displayed in RTL (right-to-left) Arabic format.
